aka: Apple Music Live: Lady Gaga Mayhem Requiem
introduction: MAYHEM: Requiem is a one-night-only exclusive concert by Lady Gaga, taking place on January 14, 2026, at The Wiltern Theatre in Los Angeles, California. This intimate, phone-free event (with devices secured in Yondr pouches) is part of her promotional activities for her seventh studio album, MAYHEM (released March 7, 2025), and is produced in collaboration with Apple Music Live for recording and streaming. The show has a limited capacity of around 2300, with tickets distributed exclusively via lottery to fans signed up for her updates—no public sales. It serves as a personal, immersive experience distinct from her larger The Mayhem Ball.
